---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem
What are you trying to do that BATHOS makes hard or impossible today?

## Proposal
What you'd like to see. If it's a domain capability, consider whether it belongs
in a **plugin module** (`modules/`) rather than the core (the core must not depend
on plugins — the A9 rule).

## Scale
Roughly what level of work is this (Lv0–4)? Which waves/roles does it touch?

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches and why they fall short.

## Additional context
Links, prior art (e.g. how other tools handle it), mockups.
